description: Choose actual Burnol/Sonine boundary dictionaries from L_a/K_a or P_a, rather than toy Gaussian boundary packets.
Define co-Poisson-native atom family g_nu with fixed support, parity, vanishing, and semilocal transport records.
Prove non-smuggled density of those atoms in the boundary-packet sector B_S.
Estimate c_N asymptotically for the native atoms.
Combine c_N with matrix moment lower bounds gamma_N from Dirichlet/Hecke character sources.
